name: Death Knell
summary: Finish a dying creature to gain temporary hit points, Strength, and caster level.
description: Touch a living creature at −1 hit points or lower. If it fails a Will save, it dies. You gain 1d8 temporary hit points, a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, and a +1 increase in effective caster level for level-dependent spell effects. The caster-level increase grants no new spells or slots. These benefits last 10 minutes per Hit Die of the creature.
duration: Instantaneous, then 10 minutes per Hit Die of the target
